summary: FAIL: 1 hard and 2 soft violations, plus 7 advisories that are not counted. All four r0 fixes were applied: Lyriel's linen, the Ch4 oven anchor, and the Garrow farm timing are resolved, and the roads line was improved. New hard V1 (L113): 'Sylvanas had been right ... about the overseer' reverses Ch5. Sylvanas took the overseer's Brill-road lie and the party lost a day with Jaina present (povKnowsAtOpen: 'They lost a day to a depot overseer's lie'). Fix: name Corley instead, or cut the clause. Soft V2 (L165): 'It goes in at the mills' asserts an insertion point Jaina said at the Ch5 fork she cannot tell, and Ch4 put the jar in a granary loft. Fix: 'It's in the flour' or 'rides in the grain'. Soft V3 (L169): 'Every grain road I've read ... is carrying it' is contradicted by her 'Nothing' read of the King's road, which carried Andorhal grain (the Elm Ferry slip). Fix: 'Every road I've read heavy south of the Pass runs to Andorhal.' Everything else holds: the chapter opens on the Ch5 close, evidence custody is correct, the knowledge ladder stops short of undeath, there is no Mal'Ganis or Kel'Thuzad, Barov stays connection, Arthas has real reasons, Sylvanas's prediction and verdict are distinct, name usage holds, the tally-man plant and farewell are clean, Cyndia and Lyriel stay silent on it, the horse and cost ladders escalate, and Andorhal is alive with Havel as a name only.
